description: Set site-wide custom code: `head` goes before </head> and `body` before </body> on every page, on every layout. It is saved as a draft and goes live with the next publish_site (on a live-mode site the dashboard publishes only the code). It never runs in the editor. Up to 20,000 characters per box, stored as sent; `warnings` flags likely mistakes (unclosed <script>, <html>/<head>/<body> tags, a canonical or robots tag, GA4 already connected) without rejecting. Send only the boxes you change; "" clears a box. `runOn` ('live' = live site only, default; 'live-and-preview' = also in the editor's preview) applies at once — agents limited to drafts can't set it. Use for tag managers (GTM), Clarity, ads pixels, chat widgets and verification tags. For plain GA4, Plausible, Fathom or Umami prefer set_analytics_provider.

body.description: Code for before </body> on every page. "" clears it.

head.description: Code for before </head> on every page. "" clears it.

runOn.description: Where it runs: 'live' (live site only) or 'live-and-preview'. Applies at once.

name: set_custom_code
